title: Yellowed Indulgent Italian Bresaola Pasta
description: A floral and gooey Italian dish featuring bresaola, tandoor spices, and a halal-friendly approach, this pasta is perfect for a special occasion. The combination of tender bresaola and creamy sauce makes for an indulgent treat.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the tandoor spice mix, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the sliced bresaola to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, whisk together the heavy cream and grated grana padano cheese until smooth.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss with the cream sauce until well coated.
Add the cooked bresaola to the pasta and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then sprinkle with chopped parsley and lemon zest.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
